title: Dollar into the London 4pm fix on the last trading day of the month
source: Melvin & Prins (2015), Equity hedging and exchange rates at the London 4 p.m. fix, Journal of Financial Markets 22
why: Foreign equity investors rebalance currency hedges at the month-end fix, a predictable flow
note: Duplicate of a live leg: the EA month-end fix leg (mql5/Include/Aurum/Legs.mqh:1035-1114) already trades the Melvin-Prins hedge flow into the London 4pm fix on the dollar pairs, signed by the stock index month-to-date move (FixTrend); this spec is an unsigned, earlier-entry version of it
